G2262.name: Er
G2262.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
G2262.short: Er is mentioned in the genealogy of Jesus as the son of Joshua.

G2242G.name: Heli
G2242G.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2242G.brief: Father of Mary and maternal grandfather of Jesus.
G2242G.short: Heli was the father of Mary and the maternal grandfather of Jesus.

G2264I.name: Herod
G2264I.desc: Tetrarch living at the time of the New Testament
G2264I.brief: A Tetrarch who persecuted the early church.
G2264I.short: Herod Agrippa I was a king who persecuted the early church, killing James and imprisoning Peter.

G2264H.name: Herod
G2264H.desc: Tetrarch living at the time of the New Testament
G2264H.brief: Tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry.
G2264H.short: Herod Antipas was the tetrarch of Galilee during Jesus' ministry and played a role in Jesus' trial.

G2264G.name: Herod
G2264G.desc: King Herod the Great: Ruler living at the time of the New Testament
G2264G.brief: The Great, Roman-appointed king of Judea during Jesus' birth.
G2264G.short: Herod the Great was the Roman-appointed king of Judea who ruled during the time of Jesus' birth.

G2266G.name: Herodias
G2266G.desc: Woman living at the time of the New Testament
G2266G.brief: Wife of Herod Antipas who had John beheaded.
G2266G.short: Herodias was the wife of Herod Antipas, who had John the Baptist beheaded at her request.

G2267.name: Herodion
G2267.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2267.brief: A relative of Paul in Rome.
G2267.short: Herodion was a relative of Paul in Rome to whom Paul sent greetings.

G2211.name: Zenas
G2211.desc: Man living at the time of the New Testament
G2211.short: Zenas, a lawyer, was commended by Paul and was to be sent on his journey with Apollos.

G2216G.name: Zerubbabel
G2216G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
G2216G.short: Zerubbabel, a descendant of David, was an ancestor of Jesus Christ.

G2265.name: Herodian
G2265.brief: A Jewish political party supporting the Herodian dynasty
G2265.short: The Herodians, mentioned in <ref="Matthew 22:16; Mrk.3.6; 12.13">Matthew 22:16; Mrk.3.6; 12.13</ref>, were a Jewish political party that supported the rule of the Herodian dynasty and collaborated with the Pharisees in their opposition to Jesus.

G2203.name: Zeus
G2203.brief: The chief god in Greek mythology
G2203.short: Zeus, the chief god in Greek mythology, was identified with the Roman god Jupiter and was worshipped in Lystra (<ref="Act.14.12-13">Act.14.12-13</ref>).
